description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about booked assistance at the airport.

files.description: A Confluence page in the customer-policies space for support agents about booked assistance at the airport, last updated between 2026-05-26 and 2026-06-30. It must contain these sentences word for word: "When assistance booked on the reservation is not provided, the customer is owed travel credit."; "assistance that was booked and not provided"; "assistance that was not booked is not covered"; "help that came late or was rude is a goodwill case". Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not mention lithium, power bank, power banks, watt-hour, watt-hours.
